sb.name: Lyra
sb.damage_resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: Lyra's weapon attacks are magical. When Lyra hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 5d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.desc: Lyra knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Lyra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Lyra's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). Lyra can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] (self only)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blade Barrier|blade barrier]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Flame Strike|flame strike]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|raise dead]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Commune|commune]], [[Tools/Spells/Control Weather|control weather]], [[Tools/Spells/Insect Plague|insect plague]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Lyra makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (4/Day)
actions.desc: Lyra touches another creature. The target magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

sb.name: Serra Angel
sb.damage_resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: The angel's weapon attacks are magical. When the angel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The angel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The angel can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Commune|commune]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|raise dead]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The angel makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.desc: The angel touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The angel magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the angel's choice). In a new form, the angel retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

traits.desc: Shalai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Shalai's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] (self only)
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blade Barrier|blade barrier]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Resurrection|resurrection]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Shalai makes two greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Slaying Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature that has 100 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die.

actions.name: Flying Sword
actions.desc: Shalai releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. If Shalai can see the sword, Shalai can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 feet and either make one attack against a target or return to Shalai's hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, Shalai is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if Shalai dies.

actions.name: Healing Touch (4/Day)
actions.desc: Shalai touches another creature. The target magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: Shalai magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Searing Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Shalai emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Blinding Gaze (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Shalai targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]] spell removes the blindness.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
